name: Son
overview: The Bible reveals the profound significance of the Son in both literal and figurative senses, emphasizing the unique relationship between God and His people. Israel is called God's firstborn son (Exodus 4:22), illustrating a special covenantal bond, while the promised Messiah is depicted as a Son given to us, bearing divine titles and authority (Isaiah 9:6). The incarnation of the Son of God through the Holy Spirit (Luke 1:35) affirms His divine nature, and John 3:16 underscores God's love demonstrated by giving His only begotten Son for salvation. The unity of the Son with the Father (John 10:30) further highlights the Son's divine identity and mission to bring eternal life to believers.
